program_gaps.evidence: DescribeCoverage silently substitutes E,N when fewer than two axisLabels are observed.
program_gaps.required: Require two explicit spatial axes from the selected CoverageDescription; no fallback.

program_gaps.evidence: GetCoverage neither requests nor records an interpolation method.
program_gaps.required: Discover supported interpolation, request an allowed method and persist it.

program_gaps.evidence: Sampler records raster resolution but does not require exactly 1m by 1m.
program_gaps.required: Require a 1m x 1m affine transform within strict tolerance.

program_gaps.evidence: Output declares ODN without proving a vertical datum identifier from response metadata.
program_gaps.required: Observe and validate ODN/EPSG:5701-compatible vertical lineage.

program_gaps.evidence: DescribeCoverage does not bind returned CoverageId/domainSet/axes to the selected coverage.
program_gaps.required: Verify returned CoverageId, domainSet, CRS, grid axes and bounds together.

program_gaps.evidence: Returned bounds, transform, band count and range unit are not bound to the requested subset.
program_gaps.required: Verify requested extent, grid alignment, one numeric band and metre units.

program_gaps.evidence: Crosschecker does not enforce 200x200, exact 50m, 10km bounds, companions or member hashes.
program_gaps.required: Enforce grid/header/tile/companion contracts and persist all hashes.

program_gaps.evidence: Multiple ASC/TXT files for one tile are concatenated and can overweight the median.
program_gaps.required: Require exactly one canonical ASC per tile and reject duplicate editions.

program_gaps.evidence: Seed URLs and filenames are not verified against the current catalogue.
program_gaps.required: Bind authority, filename and URL to the fetched current publication.

program_gaps.evidence: GML/XML members are flattened to basename without collision rejection.
program_gaps.required: Preserve safe relative paths or reject duplicate output basenames.

program_gaps.evidence: Examples and sources lack full semantic and identity uniqueness checks.
program_gaps.required: Require unique IDs, exact metric semantics and approved official HTTPS domains.

program_gaps.evidence: Resolver accepts direct download URLs and redirects without an approved final-host allowlist.
program_gaps.required: Require HTTPS and approved OS/object-storage hosts for requested and final URLs.

program_gaps.evidence: Area-only fallback can accept a generic ZIP without exact format/subformat proof.
program_gaps.required: Require explicit ASCII Grid and GML format/subformat in the selected record.

program_gaps.evidence: Configured archive/root paths can pass without current OS API/version provenance.
program_gaps.required: Require a current official manifest, archive SHA and version receipt for every source path.

program_gaps.evidence: Products/download JSON requests lack final-host, content-type, size and response-hash checks.
program_gaps.required: Require trusted host, JSON content type, bounded bytes and response hash.

program_gaps.evidence: Numeric gate accepts --wcs-url and sampler follows redirects without binding requested/final host and path to the official EA endpoint.
program_gaps.required: Pin the official HTTPS host/path and reject unapproved redirects before parsing capabilities or raster bytes.

program_gaps.evidence: Sampler rounds min/max to 0.001m before the guard recomputes and rounds span/delta, allowing sub-millimetre-to-millimetre drift to collapse.
program_gaps.required: Carry full-precision extrema through the guard and round only presentation fields after tolerance evaluation.

program_gaps.evidence: Metric guard compares only max-minus-min; a common vertical offset in min, max and median can pass the span gate.
program_gaps.required: Compare current min, max and median against pinned preserved values or independently verified datum-aligned expectations.

program_gaps.evidence: Current output copies preserved result_confidence_percent instead of recomputing confidence from current coverage, resolution, lineage and QA receipts.
program_gaps.required: Compute and bind a current confidence score; preserved confidence may be historical context only.

program_gaps.evidence: Metric guard permits missing, malformed or repeated geotiff_sha256 values and does not bind three hashes to row-specific GetCoverage receipts.
program_gaps.required: Require three valid row-bound SHA256 values plus capabilities/description hashes and reject unexpected duplicate response bytes.

program_gaps.evidence: Matcher silently transforms any declared source CRS to EPSG:27700 although the official package is natively BNG.
program_gaps.required: Require native EPSG:27700 for current official HMLR files; transformation is a blocked exception with explicit provenance.

program_gaps.evidence: Matcher uses geometry.covers(point), so a point on the boundary is labelled point-inside.
program_gaps.required: Require contains for strict interior or publish a distinct boundary status that cannot satisfy the inside gate.

program_gaps.evidence: Tile identity is inferred by a permissive filename regex and is not checked against raster bounds/xllcorner/yllcorner.
program_gaps.required: Derive expected 10km bounds from the tile code and require exact filename, bounds and header agreement.

program_gaps.evidence: Crosschecker reads band 1 after only an EPSG check; band count, numeric dtype, rotation/skew and nodata header semantics are not fail-closed.
program_gaps.required: Require one numeric band, north-up 50m transform, documented dimensions and valid NoData/header semantics.

program_gaps.evidence: Loopback verifier has no response-size or content-type gates for index, manifest, operation, source and example responses.
program_gaps.required: Apply bounded bytes and expected HTML/JSON content types before parsing.

program_gaps.evidence: Verifier computes child-file hashes but the manifest does not supply expected hashes, so current manifest identity does not cryptographically bind its children.
program_gaps.required: Require manifest-declared SHA256 and row counts for every child file and verify the manifest/index hashes.
